notes.title: Patch Note - 5
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252252/cc6ed8730348ce8fa3020a46849c6b9c04bab7c9.png"]

Hello, guests!



Thanks to a generous donation from honorable Mephisto, we've been able to continue making improvements to Hell!



Here are some of the improvements --


Visual Upgrade!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252252/82aea9bc3ffd69a7b43d8ab0af54d6b866669de8.png"]

Mr. Mephisto asked us to improve the overall atmosphere of the tower!



So, we’ve decorated the tower and surrounding Purgatory to look nicer!



Here’s the updated list!



1Chapter background upgraded.


1Chapter tilemap upgraded.


Added doors to the stronghold.


Stronghold wall design upgraded.


Bug fixes


Fixed an issue where Mammon’s magic attack during phase transition was briefly counted as inside the area even if outside.


Fixed Gear VFX appearing in cutscenes.


Fixed a rare bug where the player could be duplicated during combat.


Fixed max-level gears showing as upgradable at the Gear Workbench.


Improvements and Fixes


If the player dies after being in Mammon’s area for too long, a dedicated death animation appears.


When leaving Mammon’s area, the timer now reduces from 10s to 3s instead of resetting.


Reduced Mammon’s consecutive attack frequency.


Added dedicated execution animation when defeating Mammon.


Mouse now automatically disappears if inactive.


Player’s base movement speed and dash distance reduced.


Air-to-ground basic attacks no longer forcibly stop on landing.


Default dynamic camera setting set to low.


Projectiles from ranged enemies can now pass through passable platforms; enemies can detect players behind them.


Adjusted Crawler’s max dash distance to reduce combat interruptions.


Overheat tutorial now fills Steam Gauge to max.


Fixed frame delay between player attack animations and attack VFX.


Minimap design updated.


Added animation to remaining enemy count icon.


Boss room shortcut now works with gamepad.


Some maps redesigned.


Improved SFX.





That's all for now!



Until next time~!



Bug report: 



urbanoasisgame.official@gmail.com

notes.title: *Important updates included!* Patch Note - 4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252252/cc6ed8730348ce8fa3020a46849c6b9c04bab7c9.png"]

Hello, guests!



Thanks to a generous donation from honorable Mephisto, we've been able to continue making improvements to Hell!

Chapter 1 boss remake!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252252/60ec6c772b327aff3d7d1e15fd58c8ad24e1d6fb.png"]



In Chapter 1, , appears as the boss of the factory district instead of .



...Mammon is the manager of the factory district on the first floor of the Tower of Hell.



It is said that various items made in the factory are sent to various places in the Tower of Hell and Purgatory!



Mammon looks a little scary, but...



I think the scariest part is his ability to turn anything into precious metals...!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252252/936fada22f7f29c4b6a8735337124aa8e351163e.png"]

Mammon is... um... scary, but he's a devilish guy!



I hope you get to meet him sometime!

Fixed an issue where the attack power increase from “Power of Marchosias” gear did not automatically end, causing attack power to increase indefinitely.



Fixed an issue where players could exit the map to the right of the base.




Improvements and Fixes


A button to go directly to the boss stage has been added. Now, after entering the normal stage, you can play the boss battle immediately by pressing the F9 button.



The tutorial images, which were previously designed with keyboard users in mind, have been revised.



The camera effects when clearing a stage have been improved.



Sound effects have been added when obtaining gears.



Some sound effects have been added to the title screen.



When holding down the up/down keys in the cocktail window at the base camp, the cocktail list now scrolls.



Urban Oasis SNS links have been added to the pause screen and title screen.





That's all for now!



Until next time~!

notes.title: Patch Note - 3
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252252/cc6ed8730348ce8fa3020a46849c6b9c04bab7c9.png"]

Hello, guests!



Thanks to a generous donation from honorable Mephisto, we've been able to continue making improvements to Hell!



Here are some of the improvements --


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue where the control key guide was displayed in the first stage of the challenge even when the tutorial was viewed in its entirety without skipping.



Fixed an issue where the tutorial window UI would occasionally become blank and unresponsive.



Fixed an issue where, when playing the game with a controller, the tutorial window would automatically advance to the next page when opened while moving to the right.



Fixed an issue where, when playing the game with a controller, the gear auto-equip function would automatically activate when opening the gear crafting UI through interaction.



When changing keys, if an already assigned key was designated as a new action key, the issue where the original action key occasionally remained active has been fixed. (e.g., If the space key was previously assigned to weapon swap, and jumping was newly assigned to the space key, pressing space would simultaneously execute weapon swap and jumping.)




Improvements and Fixes


We have reduced the size of bases so that NPCs are more densely placed.



We have added the ability to open the player information window UI at bases.



We have added an option to cancel a transaction and return when trading with black market merchants at bases.



We have changed the behavior so that gears purchased from black market merchants at bases are immediately equipped.



We have added buttons corresponding to each tutorial window.



When playing the game with a controller, we added a feature where the controller vibrates when disassembling gear at the gear crafting station.



The visibility of keyboard and controller button icons has been improved.



We changed the game so that a warning window is displayed before deleting save files.



We added a “Dynamic Camera” option to the settings. This was added for those who feel dizzy due to the game's speed and camera settings. It can be set to , with the default set to .  corresponds to the camera settings from the original HellPunk.



Visual effects have been added to clearly display the dash cooldown and remaining uses.



An error where damage was being dealt to the player while the ‘Bloodline’ skill from the Sword War Inscription was active has been fixed.



To prevent situations where players have bad luck and barely get any gears, from now on, at least 1 gear will drop in every battle stage.



Added a feature where gears are automatically absorbed by the player when they drop.



The rewards for Bloodstone Rooms and Shard Rooms have been changed.

          Before: Double the amount of resources obtained when defeating enemies, 50 Bloodstones/Shards upon clearing.

          After: No increase in the amount of resources obtained when defeating enemies, 500 Bloodstones/1,000 Shards upon clearing.



The exchange rate for Bloodstones and Shards at the shop's exchange machine has been adjusted. The amount of Bloodstones required to exchange for Shards has increased.



That's all for now!



Until next time~!



Bug report: 

urbanoasisgame.official@gmail.com

notes.title: Patch Note - 2
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252252/cc6ed8730348ce8fa3020a46849c6b9c04bab7c9.png"]

Hello, guests!



Thanks to a generous donation from honorable Mephisto, we've been able to continue making improvements to Hell!



Here are some of the improvements --


Bug Fixes


Fixed duplicate gears being able to be equipped at the gear crafting table if 9 gears were already equipped.



Fixed hitting Steel-type enemies with blood instead of sparks.



Fixed the weapon swap icon not displaying when playing with a pad on the Sigil (skill swap) UI screen.



Fixed an issue where defeating enemies during the tutorial would drop Shards and Bloodstones.



Fixed an issue where trying to cancel a change with ESC while changing control keys would cause the ESC key to be bound instead of canceled.




Improvements


When starting the game from a new save slot, you will now be able to choose between Story Mode and Story Skip Mode (Story Mode will allow you to watch the intro and all cutscenes, while Story Skip Mode will skip all cutscenes). Users who choose Story Mode can also skip the intro at any point during the intro story via the pause menu.



You can set whether or not to skip cutscenes in the In-Game Settings window. If cutscene skipping is enabled, the dialog cutscenes that exist in the game will not run and will be automatically marked as complete.



Going forward, any gear in the disassembler that is a duplicate of an already equipped gear in the gear crafting table will lead to the “Swap Gear” feature, even if you don't have all 9 slots equipped, and will only be able to swap with the already equipped duplicate. This is to make it clear that you cannot have duplicates of the same gear.



New: Added an animation for when a gear is disassembled in the Gear Shop.



New: Added a blinking effect to the level and gear enhancement text when a gear is equipped at the gear crafting table that is currently available for enhancement.



In tutorials, the player's movement control icons will be changed to correspond to pad controls (L-stick) for pad users.



That's all for now!



Until next time~!



Bug report: urbanoasisgame.official@gmail.com

notes.title: Demo release delay announcement
notes.notes:
We were scheduled to release a demo on June 20th,



the game review was rejected and we're revising it again.



We'll get it fixed as soon as possible so we can release the demo as soon as possible.



We apologize again to those who have been waiting for the demo.



We hope to have the demo available by late June/early July at the latest.



Thank you.
